release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.1 adds live in-app update discovery and authorization-upgrade resilience. Open Tachyon clients now perform lightweight update metadata checks every 30 seconds and automatically surface the branded update prompt when a newer release is available; choosing Later suppresses only that specific version, while the existing staged background download, SHA-256 verification, Apply now restart, and workspace restoration flow remains intact. This patch also fixes the v0.44.x to v0.45.x authorization migration regression: an already-valid protected installation can transparently renew a stale legacy authority entitlement using its protected key digest and unchanged installation identity without asking the member to re-enter the plaintext key, while revoked, expired, invalid, and device-policy-denied licenses continue to fail closed.
